wiktionary.format: Kaikki postprocessed per-language JSONL; deprecated upstream, not raw Wiktextract data
wiktionary.modifications: Retain lowercase five-character Tagalog headwords, POS, glosses, sense tags and form/alternative relationships only. Omit enrichment categories, disambiguation, audio, examples, quotations, translations, etymology and non-Latin forms. Preserve original headwords and per-record input hashes. Optional vowel acute/grave/circumflex marks are folded for gameplay; Ñ remains distinct. No exact article revision is supplied by this snapshot.

wordfreq.author: Robyn Speer and contributors
wordfreq.modifications: Retain five-letter spelling frequency bins matching lexical evidence. For accent-folded homographs use the maximum supplied estimate, not a sum. Historical mixed-corpus spelling frequencies do not certify individual senses or contemporary regional usage.
